messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
好的！以下是我們目前提供的雕塑材料選項（您已指定「青銅」）：

| 材料 | 特點 |
|------|------|
| **青銅 (Bronze)** | 耐久、光澤度高，適合細節表現，常見於戶外與室內裝飾。 |
| **大理石 (Marble)** | 高雅、質感細膩，適合傳統與古典風格。 |
| **陶土 (Terracotta)** | 低成本、易成型，適合較小尺寸或室內展示。 |
| **木材 (Wood)** | 自然紋理，溫暖感，適合室內或戶外（需防腐處理）。 |
| **石材 (Stone)** | 堅固、重量感強，適合大型戶外作品。 |

如果您確定要訂製青銅馬雕塑，請告訴我您想要的尺寸（單位：英吋）。若不確定，我們預設尺寸為 12 英吋。您還需要其他協助嗎？
message.reasoning: The user wants to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" They want to know material options. According to the function, materials are Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. But they specifically want bronze. So we can respond with the options. Then we can offer to place an order. We should ask for size? The user didn't specify size. We can ask for size or default to 12 inches. We can also ask if they want to proceed. So we respond with options and ask for size.
